title: Automated MITRE ATT&CK Coverage Scorer for AI Governance Frameworks

original_idea.body:
# Automated MITRE ATT&CK Coverage Scorer for AI Governance Frameworks

**Problem:** AI governance frameworks address dual-use risks narratively, but it's unclear which MITRE ATT&CK tactics/techniques each framework covers. An automated mapping would reveal coverage gaps.

**Direction:** Build a Python tool that takes AI governance framework text as input and maps it to MITRE ATT&CK techniques using keyword and semantic matching. Run on Anthropic RSP, OpenAI Preparedness Framework, NIST AI 800-1 cybersecurity appendix. Output a coverage heatmap over the ATT&CK matrix.

**Why it matters:** MITRE ATT&CK is the de facto standard for cybersecurity threat coverage. Mapping governance frameworks to it would reveal which attack categories are unaddressed and enable structured framework comparison.

**Relevant context:** MITRE ATT&CK framework; Linder et al. 5-dimension framework; NIST AI 800-1 cybersecurity appendix.
